prompt.traditional: 我要一杯紅茶跟一個水果冰淇淋，一共多少錢？
prompt.simplified: 我要一杯红茶跟一个水果冰淇淋，一共多少钱？

prompt.english: I'd like a cup of black tea and a fruit ice cream. How much is that altogether?

questions.why: 紅茶 60元 + 水果冰淇淋 75元 = 135. 150 would be the tea with the chocolate ice cream (90元).

prompt.traditional: 這棟房子一個月多少錢？
prompt.simplified: 这栋房子一个月多少钱？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi yí ge yuè duōshǎo qián?
prompt.english: How much is this house a month?

questions.why: 9,000 is 九千: nine thousands. 九百 is 900 and 九萬 is 90,000.

versions.alt: A sunny living room seen from behind the TV: the back of a low TV is at the bottom middle of the picture, its screen turned toward the sofa. An older sister sits alone in the middle of the sofa facing us, watching TV, with empty seats on both sides of her. The sofa stands against the back wall. Her little brother sits on the rug one step right in front of her, in the middle, between her and the TV, with his back to her; he is watching TV too. A dog sleeps under a table with two books on top. A cat lies in the sun by the big window. There is no bird.

answer.pinyin: Kètīng lǐ yǒu liǎng ge rén.
answer.english: There are two people in the living room.

questions.why: The place comes first, then 有, then what is there: 客廳裡有兩個人. 在 needs the people first (他們在客廳裡), and 跟 (with) is not a verb.

answer.english: The dog is sleeping under the table.

questions.why: In the picture the dog sleeps under the table: 桌子下面. The books are on top of the table.

answer.pinyin: Zhè liǎng běn shū zài zhuōzi shàng.
answer.english: These two books are on the table.

questions.why: 本 counts books. 張 counts flat things such as tables and beds, and 個 is the general measure word, but books always take 本.

versions.alt: A sunny living room seen from behind the TV: the back of a low TV is at the bottom middle of the picture, its screen turned toward the sofa. An older sister sits alone in the middle of the sofa facing us, watching TV, with empty seats on both sides of her. The sofa stands against the back wall. Her little brother sits on the rug one step right in front of her, in the middle, between her and the TV, with his back to her; he is watching TV too. A dog sleeps under a table with two books on top. A cat lies in the sun by the big window. There is no bird.

answer.traditional: 弟弟在姐姐前面看電視。
answer.simplified: 弟弟在姐姐前面看电视。
answer.pinyin: Dìdi zài jiějie qiánmiàn kàn diànshì.
answer.english: My younger brother is watching TV in front of my older sister.

questions.why: In the picture the boy sits on the rug right in front of his sister, in the middle between her and the TV, with his back to her: 姐姐前面. He is not behind her (後面) or beside her on the sofa (旁邊).

answer.english: The TV is in front of the sofa.

questions.why: The TV stands in front of the sofa. The thing comes first, then 在 and the place: 電視在沙發前面. 有 would need the place first (沙發前面有電視).

prompt.traditional: 姐姐喜歡看電視，弟弟＿＿喜歡看電視。
prompt.simplified: 姐姐喜欢看电视，弟弟＿＿喜欢看电视。

answer.traditional: 姐姐喜歡看電視，弟弟也喜歡看電視。
answer.simplified: 姐姐喜欢看电视，弟弟也喜欢看电视。
answer.pinyin: Jiějie xǐhuān kàn diànshì, dìdi yě xǐhuān kàn diànshì.
answer.english: My older sister likes watching TV, and my younger brother likes it too.

questions.why: Both of them are watching TV. 也 means also: the older sister likes TV, and the younger brother likes it too. 和 joins nouns and can't sit before a verb.

passage.traditional: 我家的房子不大，可是很漂亮。客廳裡有一{1}大沙發，也有一{2}新電視。妹妹常常在客廳裡玩，我們家的狗{3}常常在那裡睡覺。我不喜歡看電視，我喜歡{4}我的房間裡聽音樂。
passage.simplified: 我家的房子不大，可是很漂亮。客厅里有一{1}大沙发，也有一{2}新电视。妹妹常常在客厅里玩，我们家的狗{3}常常在那里睡觉。我不喜欢看电视，我喜欢{4}我的房间里听音乐。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de fángzi bú dà, kěshì hěn piàoliàng. Kètīng lǐ yǒu yì zhāng dà shāfā, yě yǒu yì tái xīn diànshì. Mèimei chángcháng zài kètīng lǐ wán, wǒmen jiā de gǒu yě chángcháng zài nàlǐ shuìjiào. Wǒ bù xǐhuān kàn diànshì, wǒ xǐhuān zài wǒ de fángjiān lǐ tīng yīnyuè.
passage.english: Our house isn't big, but it's very pretty. In the living room there's a big sofa and also a new TV. My younger sister often plays in the living room, and our dog often sleeps there too. I don't like watching TV; I like listening to music in my own room.

questions.why: 張 counts flat furniture such as tables, beds and sofas: 一張大沙發.
台 counts machines: 一台電視 is a TV. 張 is for furniture.
也 means also: my sister is often in the living room, and the dog is often there too. 在 can't sit in front of 常常.
Put 在 + place before the action: 在我的房間裡聽音樂, listening to music in my room.

passage.traditional: 星期六下午，我{1}姐姐一起去喝下午茶。那家咖啡廳在學校{2}，那裡的冰淇淋都不錯，巧克力的{3}好吃。五點我們要回家，可是姐姐的錢包不在桌子上，也不在桌子下面。我們{4}椅子下面找，錢包在那裡！
passage.simplified: 星期六下午，我{1}姐姐一起去喝下午茶。那家咖啡厅在学校{2}，那里的冰淇淋都不错，巧克力的{3}好吃。五点我们要回家，可是姐姐的钱包不在桌子上，也不在桌子下面。我们{4}椅子下面找，钱包在那里！
passage.pinyin: Xīngqíliù xiàwǔ, wǒ gēn jiějie yìqǐ qù hē xiàwǔ chá. Nà jiā kāfēitīng zài xuéxiào pángbiān, nàlǐ de bīngqílín dōu búcuò, qiǎokèlì de zuì hǎochī. Wǔ diǎn wǒmen yào huí jiā, kěshì jiějie de qiánbāo bú zài zhuōzi shàng, yě bú zài zhuōzi xiàmiàn. Wǒmen zài yǐzi xiàmiàn zhǎo, qiánbāo zài nàlǐ!
passage.english: On Saturday afternoon, my older sister and I go for afternoon tea. The café is next to the school, and all the ice cream there is good; the chocolate one is the best. At five we want to go home, but my sister's wallet isn't on the table, and it isn't under the table either. We look under the chairs, and there it is!

questions.why: 跟 + person + 一起 means together with someone: 我跟姐姐一起去.
A direction word follows the place: 學校旁邊 means next to the school.
All the ice cream is good (都不錯), and the chocolate one is 最好吃, the best.
在 + place comes before the action: 在椅子下面找, look under the chairs. 再 (again) sounds the same but can't come right before a place.

text.pinyin: Zhōngmíng: Māma jīntiān hěn máng, wǎnshàng bā diǎn huí jiā. Gēge liù diǎn huí jiā, nǐmen qī diǎn zài jiā chī wǎnfàn ba. Niúròu miàn zài chúfáng lǐ, nǐmen yìqǐ chī. Māma
text.english: Zhongming: I'm very busy today and will be home at eight tonight. Your brother gets home at six; you two have dinner at home at seven. The beef noodles are in the kitchen; eat them together. Mom

prompt.pinyin: Zhōngmíng de māma jǐ diǎn huí jiā?
prompt.english: What time does Zhongming's mom get home?

questions.why: Mom writes 晚上八點回家. 六點 is when his brother gets home, and 七點 is dinner.

姐姐

text.pinyin: Dìdi: Wǒ jīntiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn yǒu kè, shíyī diǎn bàn xiàkè. Wǒmen shí'èr diǎn yìqǐ chī wǔfàn ba, wǒ qǐng nǐ. Jiějie
text.english: Little brother: Today I have class at nine in the morning and finish at half past eleven. Let's have lunch together at twelve. My treat. Your big sister

prompt.traditional: 姐姐跟弟弟幾點吃午飯？
prompt.simplified: 姐姐跟弟弟几点吃午饭？
prompt.pinyin: Jiějie gēn dìdi jǐ diǎn chī wǔfàn?
prompt.english: What time are the sister and brother having lunch?

questions.why: She writes 我們十二點一起吃午飯吧. 九點 is when her class starts, and 十一點半 is when it ends.
